name: DD-19 "Overseer" labor pool droid
description: The DD-19 "Overseer" labor pool droid, also known simply as the DD-19 "Overseer" Droid or DD-19 Overseer, was a model of supervisor droid manufactured by Ubrikkian Steamworks. A DD-19 Overseer was among the droids infected by the Iron Eclipse technovirus created by Iaco and Iaclyn Stark. Another designated DD-19 served aboard the New Republic CR90 corvette FarStar during the Galactic Civil War.
